episodes.synopsis: As U.A. students and teachers recover from the League of Villains attack on USJ, Izuku learns about why Ochaco wants to become a hero.
episodes.title: That’s the Idea, Ochaco

episodes.synopsis: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first-years as they start their qualifying round—the obstacle course race.
episodes.title: Roaring Sports Festival

episodes.synopsis: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.
episodes.title: In Their Own Quirky Ways

episodes.synopsis: Izuku’s having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.
episodes.title: Strategy, Strategy, Strategy

episodes.synopsis: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?
episodes.title: Cavalry Battle Finale

episodes.synopsis: Izuku learns more about Todoroki’s past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.
episodes.title: The Boy Born with Everything

episodes.synopsis: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso’s Quirk to advance to the next round?
episodes.title: Victory or Defeat

episodes.synopsis: It’s one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to second round?
episodes.title: Battle on, Challengers!

episodes.synopsis: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he’s up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.
episodes.title: Bakugo vs. Uraraka

episodes.synopsis: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past in a chilling battle as the two class rivals finally go head to head!
episodes.title: Shoto Todoroki: Origin

episodes.synopsis: It’s class rep versus child prodigy as Iida and Todoroki square off. Will Iida’s Reciproburst be enough to beat the boy of fire and ice?
episodes.title: Fight On, Iida

episodes.synopsis: The explosive showdown between Todoroki and Bakugo begins. Only one can take the title of first-year champion!
episodes.title: Todoroki vs. Bakugo

episodes.synopsis: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it’s time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities—their hero name!
episodes.title: Time to Pick Some Names

episodes.synopsis: The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.
episodes.title: Bizarre! Gran Torino Appears

episodes.synopsis: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.
episodes.title: Midoriya and Shigaraki

episodes.synopsis: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?
episodes.title: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students

episodes.synopsis: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.
episodes.title: Climax

episodes.synopsis: Stain is finally captured, but while the hero community deals with the consequences, an even greater challenge is set in motion.
episodes.title: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain

episodes.synopsis: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.
episodes.title: Everyone's Internships

episodes.synopsis: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It’s time to learn about One For All!
episodes.title: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past

episodes.synopsis: Finals are coming up and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.
episodes.title: Gear up for Final Exams

episodes.synopsis: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?
episodes.title: Yaoyorozu: Rising

episodes.synopsis: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.
episodes.title: Stripping the Varnish

episodes.synopsis: It’s finally time for Izuku and Bakugo’s practical exam. How can they challenge All Might without a plan?
episodes.title: Katsuki Bakugo: Origin

episodes.synopsis: Class 1-A goes shopping for training camp supplies, but things get out of hand when a villain pulls Izuku aside.
episodes.title: Encounter
